seoTitle: How to Change Your Name on eBay
metaDescription: Update your first or last name on eBay, fix a typo, or edit personalization numbers on both the desktop site and mobile app with this simple guide.
intro: Whether you need to correct a typo, update your first or last name, or adjust personalization details, changing your name on eBay is something you can do directly through account settings. This guide covers the process on both the desktop site and the eBay mobile app, along with where your name shows up to buyers.

steps.heading: Open your eBay account settings
steps.body: Log in to eBay and go to your account settings, where personal information including your name is managed.

steps.heading: Edit your first or last name
steps.body: Update the relevant name field to correct a typo or reflect a legal or preferred name change.

steps.heading: Adjust personalization numbers if needed
steps.body: If your account uses numbers or extra text for personalization, edit those fields the same way as your name.

steps.heading: Repeat the process on the mobile app if preferred
steps.body: The same changes can be made through the eBay mobile app if that's your preferred way to manage your account.

steps.heading: Confirm the update is saved
steps.body: Save your changes and check your account profile to confirm the new name is now displayed correctly.

faq.question: Will buyers see my updated name immediately?
faq.answer: Your name is used on invoices and shipping labels, so once updated it should reflect correctly for future transactions.

faq.question: Are there limits to how often I can change my name on eBay?
faq.answer: Yes, eBay has limits on how frequently you can edit your name, so it's best to make sure the change is accurate before saving.

faq.question: Can I change my name from the eBay app instead of desktop?
faq.answer: Yes, the same name and personalization edits can be made through the eBay mobile app.

faq.question: Does changing my name affect my seller or buyer history?
faq.answer: No, updating your name doesn't erase or affect your existing transaction history on eBay.
